source.oracle_body: Whenever a Mountain you control enters, put a quest counter on this enchantment. If it has six or more quest counters on it, sacrifice it. If you do, search your hand and/or library for a Dragon card and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle. Mountaincycling {2}.

assertion_map.obligation: Paid {1}{R} enchantment. Each actual controlled Mountain entry, including a foreign-owned land, gives one counter only when its trigger resolves. Other lands and opposing controlled Mountains are excluded. The six-counter threshold is checked at resolution.

Hand only, library only, and both zones; finding zero even with eligible cards present; chosen own Dragon enters without a cast or mana payment. Wrong-quality and opposing cards are rejected. Hand, library and selected identity remain private. Shuffle occurs exactly when the library is searched.
Admitted Barkform Harvester qualifies through intrinsic Changeling. The immutable printed program has only a Dragon subtype predicate, without a creature-card restriction.
Doubling Season modifies Quest counter placement and reaches six from four. Rest in Peace changes the sacrifice destination to exile, which still completes the sacrifice and permits searching.
An absent source, a new source incarnation, and a source controlled by another player cannot pay the sacrifice. No search follows; the new incarnation is untouched.

Raw/index equivalence, restore, wrong actor and out-of-range rollback at zone choice, card choice and selected-card phases. Independent children survive parent disposal. A selected card that leaves and returns is stale. The opponent never sees its hidden selected identity.

Unpayable activation is rejected transactionally. Generic two mana plus discard is paid. Private Mountain-only search reveals the chosen Mountain in hand and shuffles. Moving a Mountain into hand does not produce a quest counter.
Two actual token Mountain entries use the existing per-entrant trigger collector. The source sacrifices successfully once, searches once, and any old-source trigger finishes harmlessly.

Incrementing a Quest counter at u64 maximum fails on the actual resolving Pass and preserves revision, snapshot and both observations. Quest counters round-trip through canonical sparse named-counter JSON.

Explicit generic Any-filter helper roots: noncreature Prophetic Prism enters; instant Shock stays private in hand under CR304.4. Secluded Courtyard pre-entry choice suspends library shuffling, with raw/index, parent disposal and restore determinism.
Cycling for two mana is legal in opposing combat. Rest in Peace replaces the discard with exile but the cost is paid. Finding zero is legal despite an eligible Mountain and still shuffles.
